name: Autotrader
description: Autotrader is the UK's largest digital automotive marketplace, providing REST APIs through the Autotrader Connect platform for vehicle listings, dealer stock management, VIN and VRM lookups, vehicle valuations, retail metrics, taxonomy, images, deals, and consumer-facing search.

hasPart.name: Autotrader Vehicles API
hasPart.description: Provides VRM and VIN lookups, MOT history, vehicle features, valuations, and retail metrics for individual vehicles.

hasPart.name: Autotrader Taxonomy API
hasPart.description: Provides structured data for vehicle makes, models, generations, and derivatives.

hasPart.name: Autotrader Stock API
hasPart.description: Enables retailers to manage their forecourt inventory programmatically.

hasPart.name: Autotrader Images API
hasPart.description: CDN-backed image storage and management API for vehicle adverts.

hasPart.name: Autotrader Search API
hasPart.description: Provides filtered and sorted access to consumer vehicle adverts on the Autotrader marketplace.

hasPart.name: Autotrader Valuations API
hasPart.description: Delivers current UK market vehicle valuation data based on real-time Autotrader marketplace signals.

hasPart.name: Autotrader Vehicle Metrics API
hasPart.description: Provides supply, demand, and pricing intelligence metrics to help retailers understand market positioning.

hasPart.name: Autotrader Deals API
hasPart.description: Manages the full deal lifecycle between buyers and dealers on the Autotrader platform.

hasPart.name: Autotrader Part Exchange API
hasPart.description: Manages part-exchange vehicle transactions allowing dealers to appraise and accept trade-in vehicles.

hasPart.name: Autotrader Co-Driver API
hasPart.description: AI-powered API that generates vehicle advert descriptions and optimizes image ordering for vehicle listings.

hasPart.name: Autotrader Finance API
hasPart.description: Beta API supporting finance application and quote management for vehicle purchases.

hasPart.name: Autotrader Future Valuations API
hasPart.description: Returns predicted vehicle valuations for a specified future date.

hasPart.name: Autotrader Historic Valuations API
hasPart.description: Provides access to historical vehicle valuation data, enabling trend analysis and retrospective pricing research.
